name: own-your-diff
description: Explain the unpushed change in an HTML walkthrough, quiz the author, and block pushes of unquizzed commits.

interface.shortDescription: Walk through and quiz on a change before it is pushed
interface.longDescription: Before a push, the agent writes an HTML walkthrough of the unpushed commits and quizzes the author on the design. A git pre-push hook blocks commits without a passed quiz, and a shell guard stops the agent from pushing with --no-verify.
defaultPrompt: Run own-your-diff on my unpushed commits and quiz me
